title: Retry path drops assistant and tool transcript metadata
reasoning: The immediate assistant entry persists timestamp and structuredPayload, but the queued retry options omit both fields; the tool retry options omit timestamp even though the immediate tool entry persists it. When persistProjectionEntry rejects, queueForRetry stores only retryOptions, so a later retry can recreate a transcript entry without the original metadata. That corrupts transcript ordering/audit details specifically on the failure path.
reproduction: Force persistProjectionEntry/storeTranscriptEntry to reject while calling recordAssistantMessage with timestamp and structuredPayload, or recordToolMessage with timestamp; then flush pending messages and inspect the stored retried transcript entry metadata.
recommendation: Include the same metadata in retryOptions that buildEntry writes for the immediate entry, at least timestamp for assistant/tool entries and structuredPayload for assistant entries. Keep the immediate and retry entry construction paths parity-tested.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The feature metadata lists no linked tests, and the excerpt shows no test coverage for failed persistence followed by pending-message retry metadata parity.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a focused renderer/runtime test that mocks persistence failure, records assistant/tool messages with timestamp and structuredPayload, flushes pending messages after session resolution, and asserts the retried stored entry preserves the same metadata as the immediate build path.
minimumFixScope: Update desktopTranscriptProjectionRuntimeClient retryOptions for assistant/tool messages and add a focused retry-path parity test.
